reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 32. Nay or No: 6. Not Voting: 2. Of 38 Yea or Nay votes where the Republican majority could be computed, 37 (97%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 211 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

posts.text:
I’m in Washington, D.C. this week for votes, so I’m glad my team could join Minnesota veterans and their families at Veterans Day Programs in Duluth and Brainerd. Both events were meaningful tributes to those who have served and sacrificed.
 
Minnesota’s 8th District is home to https://t.co/pxSUp8RFrN

This Veterans Day, we honor the brave men and women who put on the uniform to defend our freedoms and way of life.

We are the land of the free because of the brave.

To all our veterans, our active-duty service members, and their families, I say thank you. The debt of gratitude we owe can never fully be repaid.

Congratulations to @Jim_Jordan, my fellow Minnesotan @GOPMajorityWhip, and @RepLisaMcClain on being elected to House Republican Leadership for the 120th Congress. 

All three are strong conservative leaders who will stand firm against radical policies and keep fighting for the American people. I look forward to working alongside them!

Today marks 51 years since the Edmund Fitzgerald sank in Lake Superior, taking 29 souls with her. 

As someone who was born and raised on the shores of Lake Superior, I will never forget the wreck of the Edmund Fitzgerald and the men who never returned home. 

As we remember this https://t.co/nXSGWENJtp
The 2026 Minnesota firearms deer opener is already underway! Wishing all of our hunters across the 8th District a safe and successful hunt! Shoot straight! https://t.co/XAEfozadmS

Happy Election Day, Minnesota!

Make sure to vote and make your voice heard.

Check your polling location here: https://t.co/tuLWKacosv

Fraudsters are on notice. Steal from Minnesota taxpayers, and you will be arrested and prosecuted.

Thank you to the FBI for confronting the fraud crisis that has drained our state for years under the failed leadership of Tim Walz and Peggy Flanagan. https://t.co/V2Rz2KvQZe

Today, I led a letter urging the Air Force Secretary to base an F-35 fleet at the @148FW.

The 148th Fighter Wing plays a crucial role in defending the homeland, and equipping them with the most lethal and connected fighter jet would further strengthen their mission.

I will continue this advocacy until the job is done!

The Small Business Administration has announced that Economic Injury Disaster Loans will be available to small businesses and private nonprofit organizations in Aitkin, Carlton, Cook, Itasca, Koochiching, Lake, and St. Louis Counties that suffered economic losses during the wildfires in Northern Minnesota this past summer. 

Eligible applicants can apply here: https://t.co/KxTTzRx7tv

Today I sat down with county commissioners and legislators from Aitkin, Crow Wing, and Cass Counties to discuss how Minnesota’s fraud epidemic is impacting them at the local level. They shared what tools they need to better protect taxpayers and the services Minnesotans rely on.

We also talked about the unacceptable reality that state leaders like Tim Walz and Peggy Flanagan turned a blind eye while fraud spiraled out of control. Minnesotans deserve better!

Proud to join my Minnesota Republican colleagues in condemning Hasan Piker’s appearance in our state.

Hateful rhetoric has no place in Minnesota. Shame on any Democrat who chooses to share a stage with him. https://t.co/d29m4Ig8ZQ

I recently stopped by the City of Tamarack to celebrate the $1.1 million in Community Project Funding I secured for their water treatment plant replacement project. This investment will protect community health and deliver the clean water that families and small businesses depend https://t.co/XMMFYLKRD6

A huge thank you to the Brainerd Chamber of Commerce for sitting down with me today! We had a great conversation about what I’m doing to deliver for Northern Minnesota, including historic tax relief for small businesses and the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act to return the dream of homeownership to American families. 

This work starts with local leaders like the Brainerd Chamber, whose insight is incredibly valuable.

I just wrapped up a great visit to Central Lakes College in Brainerd, where I took questions from political science students, and then got a firsthand look at the welding program that’s putting students on a path to skilled-trades careers. 

It was inspiring meeting so many dedicated students and educators. With their skills and determination, the future of Minnesota is bright!

Earlier today, I toured Kettle Falls in Voyageurs National Park to see the progress on the Kettle Falls Powerline Project, which is funded through the Great American Outdoors Act. 

This historic destination is one of the park’s most special places, and replacing the aging https://t.co/kgAqOxrJcI

I recently met with County Commissioners and local leaders from the southern part of #MN08 to discuss Minnesota’s fraud epidemic and the toll it’s taking on our counties. 

Our communities shouldn’t have to pay the price for the failed leadership in the metro area. Minnesotans https://t.co/r6N2lMSqed

The amount of fraud allowed to occur under the Walz-Flanagan administration is sickening.

That’s why I joined @MNThinkTank in Chisago County today to discuss the federal response to this issue - including my FRAUD Act, which will hold state leaders who turn a blind eye to fraud accountable.

Thank you to everyone who came out!

The horrific scenes out of France should serve as a warning for every American.

They imported the third world into their country, and now migrant and communist groups are burning down Paris.

If the radical left takes control, they will reopen our borders again, and what’s happening in France will arrive in our country.

Never forget that.

For 17 months straight, there have been ZERO releases at our southern border.

All we needed to fix the border crisis was new leadership. https://t.co/NM1U15u82q

I’m proud to sign @VP's Pledge to protect Americans from fraud.

Taxpayer dollars should help Americans who need assistance, NOT line the pockets of criminal fraudsters.

This is something that every American should agree on. https://t.co/FSmlXsz3eH

It was a privilege to host a roundtable in McGregor to hear directly from Minnesota’s cattlemen on how I can assist them at the federal level. Our conversation only deepened my gratitude for these hardworking Minnesotans who keep food on America’s tables. In Congress, I will always work to grow the American herd and lower the cost of fuel and fertilizer.

Farmers across Northern Minnesota are dealing with the consequences of a booming gray wolf population.

And because gray wolves remain on the Endangered Species List, there is nothing they can do to protect their herds.

I am happy to see the Trump Administration continue to take steps to assist farmers and protect livestock from wolf predation.

It was great to stop by Milaca Meats today. They run an impressive operation, processing both farm-raised meat and wild game, and offering retail products like sausages and beef jerky. Small businesses like this are the heart and soul of the 8th District! https://t.co/YaS9TZg2K3

I was proud to celebrate the opening of a new hangar at the Duluth International Airport which will house Life Link III, a critical air medical transport service that will save lives across the Northland. 

Investments like this are so crucial to our community and I applaud everyone who helped make this project a reality.

This National Loggers Day, I was proud to meet with loggers and timber producers from the Minnesota Timber Producers Association and Minnesota Forest Industries to talk through critical issues impacting their work. Minnesota’s loggers and timber industry strengthen our communities every day, and I’ll always stand with them.
On National Loggers Day, I’m grateful to the men and women of Minnesota’s timber industry who protect our forests and keep our economy moving. https://t.co/gsrQXE0tc3

On Friday, I toured Pivotal Manufacturing in Braham to see the creative ways they support our Navy by building parts for our submarine fleet. We had a productive discussion on the importance of prioritizing rural America by creating and retaining good jobs in our rural communities.

Today I held a Military Family Support Roundtable in Forest Lake where I sat down with service providers to directly discuss the ongoing needs of our military families. Thank you to all who participated in the discussion. I will not stop fighting for the resources we need to take care of our veterans, active-duty personnel, and their families.

Whether it's fraud, gang violence, or Islamic Extremism - the criminals within Minnesota's Somali community and the Democrats who are enabling them need to be held to account. 

Thank you, @POTUS, for calling out Minnesota's failed Democrat leaders who have let this problem spiral out of control.

It was a pleasure visiting with the Mayor of Crosslake to discuss the community flagpole project. Initiatives like this are a fantastic way to showcase our patriotism and bring the community together. Let’s get it done! 🇺🇸 https://t.co/jOFlNhmkef

It was an honor to deliver remarks today at the 5th Annual Armed Forces Tribute at the beautiful Brainerd All Veterans Memorial.

We must never take for granted the freedoms we enjoy every single day thanks to our veterans' service, courage, and sacrifice. We are forever in their debt, and I will continue to fight every day in Congress to support our veterans.

The U.S. Attorney's Office has confirmed that a man of Somali descent is in custody for plotting an ISIS-inspired mass casualty attack at the Mall of America. I am grateful to law enforcement for swiftly detaining this dangerous terrorist.

Islamic extremism poses a real threat to our state and nation. We cannot continue to allow people into our country who want to kill us!!

Today marks three years since Hamas carried out the deadliest attack against the Jewish people since the Holocaust. 1,200 innocent lives were stolen, and 251 hostages were taken into Gaza to face horrific captivity and torture.

Today, we remember the lives lost, we remember the hostages, and we remember the unimaginable pain that the families of the victims carry.

America will never forget this brutal act of barbarism, and we will always stand with Israel.

It was an honor to join Bill’s Wish at the Carry the Light event this weekend in Forest Lake to raise awareness about the veteran suicide crisis, a challenge our country must confront with urgency and compassion.

I shared a brief update on the work we’re doing at the federal level to improve treatment for conditions like PTSD and strengthen the transition to civilian life. Our veterans have given so much, and it is up to all of us to care for them and their families when they return home.

More Somali gang violence in the Twin Cities, this time at a football game in Eden Prairie. What will it take for Democrat “leaders” like Walz, Flanagan, and Ellison to actually do something about this escalating threat in our Minnesota communities? https://t.co/kkACY3Ssy6

Are you interested in attending one our nation’s prestigious Service Academies? If so, please consider attending the Service Academy Admissions Forum at Cretin-Derham Hall High School in St. Paul on Saturday, October 10th from 2:00 to 4:00pm. 

You can RSVP to this forum using the following link: https://t.co/v8e1JtCRiD

It was a privilege to attend the @CCAInstitute’s Angels in Adoption Celebration this week to honor advocates for adoption and foster care. 

I know the importance of opening homes to children in need – not too long ago, two wonderful children came into our lives as foster children, and now they are beloved members of our family. It was great to meet other families and learn about how fostering and adoption have blessed their lives.

Weird… I thought Democrats said this doesn’t happen?

Only Americans should be voting in American elections. 

The Senate needs to pass the SAVE America Act! https://t.co/yAZLeRzifx

Under Democrat leadership, Minnesota became ground zero for welfare fraud. Now these same leaders are enabling election fraud through the state’s controversial voter vouching system.

We can’t fix what we can’t measure, which is why I introduced the Voter Vouching Transparency Act to understand the full scope of the issue here in Minnesota and nationwide. Learn more: https://t.co/3C20zJ7VYj

I commend President Trump for working to revitalize America’s steel industry, and I’m glad the Iron Range will play a vital role in this national effort.

But it's frustrating that poor leadership under the Walz-Flanagan administration resulted in this $15 billion steel plant going to Iowa instead of Minnesota.

We need state leaders who make Minnesota a place that welcomes investment and the jobs that come with it! https://t.co/Lk4xsjoKAy

It was great to meet with the Mayor of North Branch and city staff yesterday to discuss the expansion of their industrial park. Projects like this are crucial to ensuring our rural communities continue to thrive. https://t.co/2l8aPvXJqE

Yesterday, I met with the Forest Lake Chamber of Commerce to share an update on my work in Congress helping small businesses and families thrive — from advancing the Working Families Tax Cuts that made the small business deduction permanent at 20%, to supporting the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act that keeps the American Dream of homeownership within reach. I’ll always stand with small businesses and families across Minnesota’s 8th District!

Stopped by the Invisible Wounds Project in Forest Lake to thank them for the work they do supporting our first responders. 

Grateful for their tireless dedication to serving those who serve us. https://t.co/k6Eynv1FEW

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Housing for the 21st Century Act (H R 6644)
roll_calls.plain_language: This bill establishes and modifies various federal housing programs. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Concur in Senate Adt to House Adt to Senate Adt — Housing for the 21st Century Act (H R 6644)
roll_calls.plain_language: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act establishes and modifies various federal housing programs. This vote, under suspension of the rules, was on accepting the Senate's latest changes to the bill after the chambers traded versions, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea accepts the Senate's version; a Nay opposes it.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
